thread:
Alex: Quick ask — can we capture customer feedback as short 'cards' for product sprint planning? Need ~8–10 concise cards by EOD Wed. I’ll seed 3. Please use the template below and drop rows in the sheet: https://tinyurl.com/rw-feedback-cards :sparkles:

```
Customer: [name]
Problem / pain: 1–2 lines
Feature ask or behaviour change: 1 line
Impact: usage / renewal / ops cost / UX (brief)
Priority: P0 / P1 / P2
Reporter + context: call/email + date
Links: recording / ticket / screenshot
Action owner: (CS / PM / Eng)
```

Brynn: On it. I’ll add 4 from this week’s onboarding calls. Quick q — are we treating renewal-risk signals as higher priority by default?

Mike (PM): Yes — tag items that include churn/renewal language with "renewal-risk" and add a rough impact estimate (revenue at risk or % of usage). Use P0 for blockers that block renewal conversations.

Devon: Heads-up: for any UX pain, include repro steps or a short Loom. Product can’t triage without it. If they can’t record, list steps and affected flows.

Nora: I can draft a one-paragraph script for CS to use on calls so we get clearer asks (will reduce fishing). When’s the hard deadline?

Alex: EOD Wed — that’s the ask. If someone can’t make that, add whatever you have and mark as "partial".

Brynn: Adding first card now:
Brynn: Card -> Customer: Acme Retail | Ask: per-route cost breakdown | Pain: finance can’t map charges to teams | Impact: renewal flagged (Q2) | Priority: P1 | Reporter: Onboarding call 3/7 | Links: https://acme.notionsite/recap | Action owner: Mike (PM)

Mike (PM): Nice. @Devon can you take tech triage on that one? If it needs infra, flag DB / billing @data-team.

Devon: I’ll take it and two others. If it requires new metric exports, I’ll ping infra.

CS Bot: Reminder: Alex created the sheet row (automated) — https://sheet.link/abc. Add card id when you paste.

Nora: Also adding an enablement ask: "How to ask about tokenization vs embeddings" — this is more of a playbook item than product but good to surface here.

Alex: Perfect. We’ll review top 10 in Thurs standup and lock top 3 into sprint backlog. If anything looks like an immediate-risk for renewal, call it out in the card title with [RENEWAL-RISK]. :thumbsup:

Brynn: Will do. Thanks — adding the rest now.

Mike (PM): If anyone’s unsure on priority, mark P2 and I’ll audit later.

Devon: Quick note — for any ask that includes "per-route" or billing tables, add example rows or CSV snippet if possible.

Alex: Great. Closing loop — standup sync Thurs 9:15. Thanks team. :party_parrot:
